meta.name: add-ollama-provider
meta.description: Route a NanoClaw agent group to a local Ollama model instead of the Anthropic API. Ollama speaks the Anthropic API natively (v1/messages), so no provider code changes are needed — just env var overrides and a model setting. Use when the user wants to run their agent locally, cut API costs, or experiment with open-weight models. See docs/ollama.md for background.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把智能体切换到本地模型，减少接口调用成本。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你想用本地模型运行 AI 助手，省下 API 调用费。
copy.tagline_en: Switch your AI assistant to a local model and save API costs.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to run your AI assistant locally and cut API costs.

howto.what: 把指定 agent group 的请求从 Anthropic API 改到本机 Ollama 模型:在 container.json 写入 env 变量与可选的 blockedHosts,在共享 settings.json 里设置 model,再重建并重启服务;回退时删掉这些键即可。
howto.when: 当你想把 agent 跑在本机、降低 API 成本或试用开放权重模型时触发。前提是本机已安装并运行 Ollama、已拉取模型,且 agent group 已存在。

say.text: 帮我把 agent group 的请求转到本机 Ollama 模型上
say.note: 随后会问选哪个模型、是否屏蔽 Anthropic API

say.text: 把这个 agent group 的 model 改成 qwen3-coder
say.note: 写入共享 settings.json 的 model 键

say.text: 把这些改动撤掉,改回 Anthropic API

howto.what_en: Points a NanoClaw agent group at a local Ollama model instead of the Anthropic API: writes env vars and optional blockedHosts into container.json, sets model in the shared settings.json, then rebuilds and restarts the service.
howto.when_en: Use when the user wants to run the agent locally, cut API costs, or try open-weight models. Assumes Ollama is installed and running with a model pulled, and the agent group already exists.

say_en.text: Route my agent group to a local Ollama model
say_en.note: It then asks which model and whether to block the Anthropic API

say_en.text: Change this agent group's model to qwen3-coder
say_en.note: Writes the model key in the shared settings.json

say_en.text: Revert these changes back to the Anthropic API
say_en.note: Removes env, blockedHosts and model, then restarts
